entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        lci.DEPARTMENT,
        tm.TITLE,
        tm.AUTHOR,
        tm.ISBN,
        lrm.TERM_CODE,
        lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
        lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
        ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
    LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
        ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
    LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
        ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        DEPARTMENT,
        TITLE,
        AUTHOR,
        ISBN,
        TERM_CODE,
        COUNT(LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS total_instructors_per_library_book,
        COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_materials_available_in_library
    FROM base
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT, TITLE, AUTHOR, ISBN, TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
    DEPARTMENT,
    TITLE,
    AUTHOR,
    ISBN,
    TERM_CODE,
    CASE WHEN total_materials_available_in_library > 0
         THEN 'Available in Library'
         ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS availability,
    total_instructors_per_library_book,
    total_materials_available_in_library,
    SUM(total_materials_available_in_library) OVER () AS total_available_materials_all_departments
FROM agg
